item.title: Generative AI and LLM in financial modelling and applications
item.content:encoded:
Steve Yang, Stevens Institute of Technology

Jing Chen, Cardiff University

Aparna Gupta, Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute

Zachary Feinstein, Stevens Institute of Technology

William Knottenbelt, Imperial College

This special issue examines how Generative AI and Large Language Models are transforming financial modelling and applications. It welcomes research that explores AI's impact on traditional finance areas including asset pricing, financial intermediation, markets and investment, behavioral finance, banking, accounting, and insurance. The editors are particularly interested in work addressing ethical implications, financial inclusion benefits, and regulatory changes driven by these technologies.

The rapid adoption of tools like ChatGPT has sparked renewed interest in AI applications within finance. While Generative AI shows promise for enhancing data generation, analysis, decision-making, and risk management, research on its modelling and applications remains nascent. Simultaneously, significant challenges have emerged around data privacy, regulatory frameworks, innovation disruption, and the need to maintain human-centered approaches in financial systems.

Appel publié par The European Journal of Finance. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
